summary.text: Farooq Mughal is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 105 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He represented District 105 from January 2023 to January 2025 and lost re-election in 2024 by 80 votes.

paragraphs.text: Mughal lived in Dacula, Georgia, as of the 2023-2024 legislative session, and earned a bachelor's degree in criminal justice and sociology from Mercer University in 2000, according to Ballotpedia.

His career experience includes work as principal and managing partner and a general civil mediator with MSGlobal Partners, and he served as president of the FBI Atlanta Citizens Academy Alumni Association and chair of the Gwinnett County Community Outreach Advisory Board.
Mughal won the 2022 general election for District 105, defeating Republican Sandy Donatucci, 51.7 percent to 48.3 percent, and took office on January 9, 2023.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Judiciary Non-Civil, Special Rules, and State Planning and Community Affairs committees.
Donatucci defeated him in the 2024 general election, 15,142 votes to 15,062, and Mughal left office on January 13, 2025.
He advanced from the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary.
